major_findings.finding: A filler-only partial can be committed as backchannel at VAD end before a later meaningful final transcript arrives.
major_findings.required_resolution: Wait for the attributed final transcript or a bounded post-VAD deadline before committing a negative result. Eligible timeout, error or empty final must fail toward interruption.

major_findings.finding: Positive decisions from partial transcripts have no revision, replacement, stability or confidence contract.
major_findings.required_resolution: Define ordered transcript revisions and the exact evidence allowed to commit an irreversible positive decision.

major_findings.finding: The design says VAD owns candidate creation but also permits STT-first candidate creation.
major_findings.required_resolution: Keep STT-first packets as bounded pre-candidate evidence or explicitly define STT-created candidate ownership and expiry.

major_findings.finding: Usable, empty and low-confidence transcript behavior is undefined.
major_findings.required_resolution: Define finality, confidence, language, empty-result and invalid-confidence handling.

major_findings.finding: An English-only filler list is unsafe as the default for multilingual sessions.
major_findings.required_resolution: Define supported languages and fail-toward-input behavior for unknown or unsupported languages.

major_findings.finding: Fallback to VAD can be impossible when min_words remains enabled but attributed STT is unavailable.
major_findings.required_resolution: Define the effective fallback thresholds and compatibility behavior.

major_findings.finding: Decision, event, byte and retention limits and overflow ownership remain incomplete or inconsistent.
major_findings.required_resolution: Set exact bounds, deadline origin, non-reset rules and preservation behavior for the bound-crossing packet.

major_findings.finding: The proposed file scope does not include the STT construction paths needed to preserve segment identity and capture timestamps.
major_findings.required_resolution: Add exact STT provider paths and parity tests or define a reviewed shared attribution boundary.

minor_findings.finding: The RFC body still identifies amendment 01 as current.
The test matrix omits late final, partial retraction, empty final, confidence, language fallback, rejected lifecycle commit and retained-disposition concurrency cases.

cycle_limit.next_action: Escalate unresolved decisions to the repository maintainer. Do not start another correction cycle or implementation.
